Taylor: Quick spike: legal flagged example outputs that resemble real PII. With the v1->v2 deprecation + model alias swap next month we need: a short migration guide, sanitized snippets (TS/py/curl), and a link check.
Ibrahim: Can script replace for email/phone patterns and keys. Will replace with tokens <NAME>/<EMAIL>/<REDACTED_KEY> and produce a report. Branch: docs/sanitize-6990.
Nina: SDK breaking notes: models.generate -> responses.create; createEmbedding(dimension=...) -> embeddings.create(vector_dim=...). I'll draft compact side-by-side snippets.
Taylor: Prioritize quickstarts and samples used in onboarding. Add deprecation banners on v1 pages that link to the migration guide and set up redirects to avoid 404s.
Ibrahim: I'll open incremental PRs with preview builds so legal can review small changes.
pat-docs-bot: placeholder CI run queued: https://ci.internal.redwood/6990
legal: Please include a brief footer: "Examples sanitized for privacy." We'll prioritize review once PRs are up.
Nina: Snippet sketch to include in migration guide:
```js
// v1
await client.models.generate({model: 'redwood-v1', input: 'hi'})
// v2
await client.responses.create({model: 'redwood-v2', input: 'hi'})
```
Taylor: Assignments: Ibrahim (sanitize script + PRs), Nina (snippets + migration guide draft), Taylor (banners + redirects + legal coord). Drop PR links here as you create them. Aim: first PRs tomorrow, full rollout by next Friday.
